headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Neha Bora traced to RK Puram station after hours of uncertainty.
Minister reviews Vemulawada temple expansion, development works.
INDIA bloc leaders in Bihar take out Aakrosh March against ECI.
Iran must cut enrichment to end war, U.S. Vice-President Vance says.
Odisha govt. forms panel to study SEBC political backwardness.
bullets_ur: Ghanton ki ghair-yaqeeni ke baad Neha Bora RK Puram station se mil gayeen.
Wazir ne Vemulawada mandir ki tousee aur taraqqiati kaamon ka jaiza liya.
Bihar mein INDIA bloc ke rehnumaon ne ECI ke khilaf Aakrosh March nikala.
Jang khatam karne ke liye Iran ko enrichment kam karni hogi, U.S. Vice-President Vance ka bayan.
Odisha hukumat ne SEBC ki siyasi pasmandagi ka jaiza lene ke liye panel tashkeel diya.
